explanationMd: At60s P has risen32-20=12degrees and Q26-20=6degrees;12:6=2:1.

distractorRationale.a: Equal heating duration does not give equal temperature rise.
distractorRationale.b: This compares absolute temperatures32 and26 after simplifying, rather than rises.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses the ratio of rises.
